claim.claim-text: 1. A handle assembly for a prosthesis delivery device comprising:

2. The handle assembly of any preceding claim, further comprising a second handle, the second handle being rotatable relative to the main handle, the second handle having a threaded internal surface, wherein a follower is disposed within the second handle and the threaded internal surface of the second handle engages a protrusion extending radially outwardly from the follower.
3. The handle assembly of claim 2, wherein the protrusion has a generally conical, domed or rounded trapezoidal shape.

4. The handle assembly of any preceding claim, comprising a first groove formed in at least a portion of the outer surface of the main handle, wherein the first trigger wire is contained in the first groove when the first trigger wire is in the prosthesis release condition.

5. The handle assembly of claim 4 comprising a second groove formed in at least a portion of the outer surface of the main handle, wherein the second trigger wire is contained in the second groove when the second trigger wire is in the prosthesis release condition.
6. The handle assembly of claim 5, wherein the first and second grooves are helical; wherein:

the second helical groove is wound in an opposing direction than the direction of the first helical groove; and/or the second trigger wire actuation mechanism is a ring disposed over at least a portion of the second helical groove formed in the outer surface of the main handle.
7. The handle assembly of claim 5 or 6 wherein the first helical groove has a start point and an end point and wherein the second helical groove has a start point and an end point.

8. The handle assembly of claim 7 wherein a first opening is formed in the outer surface of the main handle at at least one of the start point and end point of the first helical groove and wherein a second opening is formed in the outer surface of the main handle at at least one of the start point and end point of the second helical groove; wherein the first opening and the second opening optionally are adjacent and longitudinally spaced from each other.

9. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein movement of the second trigger wire actuation mechanism causes the second trigger wire to retract distally; and/or wherein the first trigger wire actuation mechanism and the second trigger wire actuation mechanism are independently rotatable relative to each other.

10. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein rotation of the second trigger wire actuation mechanism causes the second trigger wire to wrap around the outer surface of the main handle and conform to the profile of a or the second groove.

11. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein the first ratcheting mechanism is a ratchet ring disposed between the outer surface of the main handle and an inner surface of the first trigger wire actuation mechanism.

12. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein the second ratcheting mechanism is a ratchet ring disposed between the outer surface of the main handle and an inner surface of the second trigger wire actuation mechanism.

13. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein first trigger wire actuation mechanism is a rotating ring disposed over at least a portion of a or the first groove formed in the outer surface of the main handle.
14. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein movement of the first trigger wire actuation mechanism causes the first trigger wire to retract distally.

15. The handle assembly of any preceding claim wherein rotation of the first trigger wire actuation mechanism causes the first trigger wire to wrap around the outer surface of the main handle and conform to the profile of a or the first groove.
